data.description:
From the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md), audit tree 0c7d60a.

**GAP-4** (G-2, Major, new): The provenance check is not on the build path, so an uncommitted or local bank schedules without it
- Evidence: check_provenance (verify.py:577) runs in CI over committed files only (test_verify.py:425-428); schedule.refusal (schedule.py:127) and fallback.bake (fallback.py:105) skip it; the replay covers MIGRATED only (migrate_mvp.py:76); M2a survived
- What would close it: Call check_provenance in refusal and bake, and replay every bank question that has a recording

Held: an audit's findings are the client's to release. Read the gap's section in the audit report before planning; re-verify on the current main.
data.title: The provenance check is not on the build path, so an uncommitted or local bank schedules without it

data.body: Re-verified on main 58bb75d (2026-10-12), 166 commits after the audit tree 0c7d60a. STILL OPEN. check_provenance (now verify.py:632) has no caller in pipeline/src; callers are tests only (test_verify.py:553-656, test_migration.py:201). schedule.refusal (schedule.py:129) and fallback.bake (fallback.py:105) still skip it. The build path does get partial cover from bank.question_from_dict (refuses a 'correct' field) and correct_index (arrange raises when no option matches), but not the verifier-authorship checks (verified_at/verifier_version, self-contradicting records). Replay still covers MIGRATED = (q3, q4, q7, q8) only (migrate_mvp.py:76).
